other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Punjab
Applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker (unorganised sector)
Applicant must be between 18 and 60 years old
Must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a given year
Monthly income must be ₹15,000 or below
Must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund
Must not be a member of EPF, NPS, or ESIC
Must not be an income tax payer
Applicant must be a registered member/female member (for self‑marriage) of the Punjab Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board or an unmarried daughter of a member
The marriage must be the first marriage of the daughter or self
Benefits are available for up to two daughters only
Application must be submitted within 3 months after the marriage date
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹31,000 per daughter for up to two daughters' first marriages.
